'''Irisia''' is a [[Water]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Aquariel]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "As light pours down from the sky, Irisia returns from the depths of the thunderstorm, parting massive waves to clear a safe path. As long as Irisia still roams these seas, the lights of every home along the shore will stay on, steady and bright."

Irisia is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Irisia and its evolutions were added to the game on 9/23/2026 alongside [[Thunderpaw]] and [[Cinderclaw]].
